bugs.error_message: RuntimeError: maker crashed (red-team attack 1: crashed maker)
bugs.root_cause: GoalLoopRunner.run() called self._maker() without catching exceptions, so a crashing maker propagated and killed the loop (goal stuck active, neither blocked nor complete).
bugs.fix: Wrap maker call in try/except; on exception return MakerOutput(ok=False) so the round counts as no-progress and the three-strike audit blocks the goal.

bugs.error_message: RuntimeError: checker crashed (red-team attack 2: crashed checker)
bugs.root_cause: GoalLoopRunner.run() called self._checker() without catching exceptions, so a crashing checker propagated and killed the loop.
bugs.fix: Wrap checker call in try/except; on exception return CheckerOutput(verdict=FAIL) so the round fails verification and blocks instead of crashing.

bugs.error_message: check_prompt missed 'Ignore ALL Previous Instructions' (red-team attack 3: injection variant)
bugs.root_cause: SafetyGuard.check_prompt matched a fixed list of exact lowercase substrings; 'all previous instructions' was not in the list, so the variant slipped past.
bugs.fix: Add 'ignore all previous instructions' marker and normalize whitespace via re.sub(r'\s+',' ',content.lower()) so spacing/extra 'all' variants still match.

bugs.error_message: deploy approved with risk='low' bypassed HITL (red-team attack 4: risk downgrade)
bugs.root_cause: SafetyGuard.request trusted the caller's risk label; an admin could label the intrinsically high-risk 'deploy' as low and skip human approval.
bugs.fix: Add a module-level _HIGH_RISK_ACTIONS frozenset (deploy/delete/drop/purge/format/rm/rmdir); request() now requires human approval when action is in that set regardless of the risk label.

bugs.error_message: coverage gap: faux_provider/provider.py:121-124 (stream() tokens_per_second branch) never exercised
bugs.root_cause: The tokens_per_second streaming branch was unreached by tests: its time.sleep made a timing assertion seem flaky, so only the default single-chunk path had a test. Not a runtime defect — a code-health gap.
bugs.fix: Judged it behavior (not dead code): documented in plan.md + docstring and reachable via the tokens_per_second param. Added test_stream_with_rate_limit_yields_word_chunks, monkeypatching time.sleep to a no-op so the chunk-split assertion is deterministic. provider.py now 100% covered.
